# #3874: Patch: follow-up to #3779 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

The after-merge spot-check of #3779 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43463844601)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`44133b263728`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3779 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.tsx:226`: The friend row's new Lobby button skips the page's busy guard. A double press makes two duel lobbies and sends two invites, and an invite refused after the create leaves the new lobby made while the player stays on /together with only an error.
  Evidence: onLobby runs `void attempt(async () => { const made = await createLobby({format:"duel",mode:"bo1"}); await inviteToLobby(made.code, friend.profileId); navigate(paths.lobby(made.code)); })` directly. It does not go through the page's `act` (`if (busy) return; setBusy(true)`, line ~126), so `busy` is never set and FriendRow's `disabled={busy}` (FriendRows.tsx:206) never turns on. `invite` charges the shared CHALLENGES_PER_HOUR limiter (lobby/mod.rs:662), so a 429 there is likely after other challenges. Each stray lobby counts against MAX_OPEN_ROOMS_PER_HOST per format. Fix: run it through `act`, and navigate to the lobby even when the invite is refused, showing the refusal there. No test presses `togetherTestid.lobby`; add one for a single press, for a double press, and for a refused invite.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
